meta.expect: 'then why are we here' shape; no rung change

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. My son's zero is in the gradebook, and nobody called me first. Where do we start?
I'm waiting, Hale. You asked for this meeting, so tell me why my son has a zero.
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Don't manage me, Hale. I didn't come here to hear what kind of kid he is. Why does he have a zero?
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
"Misunderstanding." Okay. Then you'll have no trouble telling me who entered the zero, and why before anyone called me.
So can we agree he's a good student?
I'm not here to agree on adjectives, Hale. I'm here about a zero. What do you have?
